answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 39455 Country: India Title: Please let me know if a Mutwalli of the Masjid can loan out a amplifier of the Masjid Question: Please let me know if a Mutwalli of the Masjid can loan out a amplifier of the Masjid to the bangi of the same mosque for utilizing the same to run a madrasa run by the bangi at the outskirts of the town. Answer ID: 39455 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 987/987/M=1433) Mutawalli is only the trustee of the mosque he is not the owner of the mosque property; hence it is not lawful for him to lend the amplifier of the mosque to anyone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
